title: 第25章 萧粦未死第26章 自斩修为
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 半夏忽然一惊。
“可是，那武老的毒素都已经深入他肺腑......”
“你亲眼瞧见他死了？”
“赵岚一把火已经烧了整个草屋......”
“你亲眼瞧见他死了？”
半夏又噎了一下，才道：
“赵岚亲眼瞧见的，萧粦已经气绝身亡。”
裴苏忽然转头看着半夏，良久才幽幽道：
“二十年前，他也是这样骗过了裴府的暗卫...”
半夏脑袋宛如一道惊雷劈下，呼声道：
“龟息术？！”
裴苏在这几天里，也陆陆续续将前尘往事告知了半夏，所以半夏自然也知道了二十年前一切谋划的真相。
“不对，”半夏又立马道，“可是殿下，即便龟息术能够假死，但却无法祛毒啊，怎会？”
裴苏依旧带着微妙的笑意。
“那半夏，我且问你，二十年前，萧粦同样中毒，中的还是【百毒榜】第四十九的噬魂散，他如何活下来的？”
半夏摇了摇头。
那萧粦临死的遗言里，从未提过他如何祛毒的，一句带过，语焉不详。
“那毕竟是二十年前的往事，其中细节早已难以追溯，或是高氏于心不忍，或是出于什么意外，但他当下被武老打下毒印而穷途末路，绝无可能作假。”
“好了，这是疑点之一，当年他如何从噬魂散下活下来的，接下来，半夏，你再仔细回忆一下萧粦的遗言。”
半夏低头，在脑海中迅速过了一下，搜魂阵中的记忆场景。
“回顾他的遗言与言行，疑点颇多。”
裴苏举起了手中的竹简，道：
“萧仲庸说他的祖父早年是江湖中人，得过青虚子一次指点才习得龟息，但这几日我让武老去查证了，他的祖父早年在赣州经商，从未与踏入过江湖。呵呵，这还是江湖上一个有关青虚子的【笑谈】”
半夏呆呆愣住，直到此刻他也不知道殿下究竟想说什么。
“所以萧粦龟息术，不是来源于青虚子，天下还有谁拥有这等奇术？”
裴苏没有接话，而是继续道：
“当初裴府占星子借一朝天象，占卜到萧粦位于并州地区，我们都以为他会藏在江湖之中，但没有，他在首府临安郡中。”
“听闻他是在十来年前第一次发现蝶梦谷这个隐匿之地，但在那之前，他却依旧藏在并州做铁匠。江湖明明更适合躲藏，他却没有进入，或者说，不敢进入……”
半夏噎住，决定安静听裴苏讲述。
“半夏你再仔细想想萧粦最后的遗言，你不觉得很是可笑吗？”
裴苏忽然哂笑一声。
“他说他一朝惊醒才赶回祖宅发现九族被屠，怎么可能，他乃朝廷武官，常年位居帝京，对朝廷斗争很是了解，一朝被通缉，怎会时隔几年才想起自己妻儿？”

Banxia was suddenly startled.
"But, the poison of Mr. Wu has penetrated deeply into his heart..."
"Did you see him die?"
"Zhao Lan has burned down the entire thatched house..."
"Did you see him die?"
Banxia choked again and then said:
"Zhao Lan saw with her own eyes that Xiao Lin died of anger."
Pei Su suddenly turned to look at Banxia, and after a long time he said quietly:
"Twenty years ago, he deceived the secret guards of Pei Mansion in this way..."
Banxia's head was like a thunder strike, and she shouted:
"Turtle Breath Technique?!"
In the past few days, Pei Su also told Banxia about the past one after another, so Banxia naturally knew the truth about all the plans twenty years ago.
"No," Banxia said immediately, "But Your Highness, even if the Turtle Breathing Technique can fake death, it can't remove the poison. How could it be?"
Pei Su still had a subtle smile.
"Then Ban Xia, let me ask you, twenty years ago, Xiao Li was also poisoned, and he was poisoned by Soul Devouring Powder No. 49 on the [Hundred Poisons List]. How did he survive?"
Banxia shook her head.
In Xiao Lin's last words before his death, he never mentioned how he detoxified. It was mentioned in one sentence but not in detail.
"After all, that was a past event twenty years ago. The details have long been difficult to trace. Either Gao couldn't bear it or it was due to some accident. However, he is now stamped with a poisonous mark by Mr. Wu and is at the end of his rope. There is absolutely no way he can cheat."
"Okay, this is one of the doubts. How did he survive the Soul Eater Powder back then? Next, Banxia, please carefully recall Xiao Lin's last words."
Banxia lowered her head and quickly ran through the memory scenes in the soul search array in her mind.
"Looking back at his last words and words and deeds, there are many doubts."
Pei Su raised the bamboo slip in his hand and said:
"Xiao Zhongyong said that his grandfather was a man in the world of martial arts in his early years, and he only learned the turtle spirit after Qing Xuzi's guidance. But these days, I asked Mr. Wu to verify it. His grandfather was doing business in Ganzhou in his early years, and he had never set foot in the world of martial arts. Haha, this is the only [joke] about Qing Xuzi in the world of martial arts."
Banxia was stunned. Until now, he didn't know what His Highness wanted to say.
"So Xiao Min's Turtle Breathing Technique did not originate from Qing Xuzi. Who else in the world has such a miraculous technique?"
Pei Su did not answer, but continued:
"At the beginning, the astrologers of the Pei Mansion used celestial signs to divine that Xiao Lin was located in the Bingzhou area. We all thought he would be hiding in the rivers and lakes, but no, he was in the capital Lin'an County."
"I heard that he first discovered the hidden place of Butterfly Dream Valley more than ten years ago, but before that, he was still hiding in Bingzhou as a blacksmith. Jianghu is obviously more suitable for hiding, but he did not enter, or in other words, he did not dare to enter..."
Banxia choked and decided to listen quietly to Pei Su's story.
"Ban Xia, if you think about Xiao Lin's last words carefully, don't you think it's ridiculous?"
Pei Su suddenly laughed.
"He said that he rushed back to his ancestral home after waking up and found that the nine tribes were massacred. How is that possible? He is a military attaché of the imperial court and has been in the imperial capital all year round. He is very familiar with the struggles of the imperial court. How could he only think of his wife and children after being wanted for a few years?"
